title: Half-sibling mating
summary: Two half-siblings, who share a father, have a child: the half-sib triangle.
shows: A man (I-1) has a son with one partner (I-2) and a daughter with another (I-3). The half-siblings (II-1 and II-2) have a child (III-1), whose inbreeding coefficient is 1/8.
The shared father and the half-siblings' union form a closed triangle in the drawing.
hard: The father has two partnerships, and his two children must sit next to each other to be partners. The two partnerships have to be placed either side of him so that neither child's line crosses the other partner's symbol.
